title: Patch artifact
description: Produced in IMPLEMENT. Exact-match search/replace edits (ADR-0008). The search text MUST match the target file byte-exactly and uniquely; ambiguity is a structured rejection, never a fuzzy apply, because a fuzzy match corrupts a file in a way that may still pass verification.

base_commit.description: The tree this patch was written against. A patch whose base has moved is re-validated, never applied blind.

rationale.description: Why this change. Carried into the commit body for the human reviewer.

search.description: Must occur exactly once in the file, byte for byte. Empty only when create is true.

replace.description: May be empty, which deletes the searched text.

create.description: True when the edit creates a new file. The path MUST NOT already exist; the applier rejects it if it does.
